selection_rationale.chosen_unit: Specify and implement an opt-in read-only checkpoint/segment storage contract with exact legacy reconstruction, bounded HEAD publication authority, and adversarial damage recovery checks.
selection_rationale.scope_boundary: Research-only physical-storage validation. No existing universe event, manifest, membership, source, SEC materialization, runtime, observation, feature, candidate, signal, outcome, policy, scheduler, broker, order, allocation, evidence tier, parity status, or trading authority changed.

implementation.head_authority: A constant-size explicit HEAD record is the sole commit authority. It binds exactly one immutable checkpoint and an optional reverse hash-linked segment tail without carrying a growing segment list.
implementation.checkpoint_identity: The checkpoint freezes the exact strict legacy prefix plus event, manifest/batch, source/evidence, clock, rule, mapping, chain-head, effective-membership, and pending-future-event identity state.
implementation.segment_identity: Each immutable segment carries exactly one unchanged v1 transaction: its event rows, exact v1 manifest, predecessor hash, and before/after event and manifest counts.
implementation.strict_loading: The loader follows only the HEAD-reachable chain, requires strict canonical UTF-8 bytes and finite JSON scalars, verifies content-addressed paths and reverse links, conserves every physical event exactly once, binds segment event IDs to the manifest batch and local universe/run/effective clocks, validates checkpoint derived state, rebuilds the exact legacy events/manifests view, and delegates final semantics to the existing strict parser.
implementation.damage_model: Referenced missing, truncated, tampered, malformed, reordered, forked, boundary-escalated, or identity-drifting records fail closed without legacy fallback. Valid content-addressed orphan records not reachable from HEAD remain invisible and audit-only.
implementation.claim_boundary: This is contract_only_unwired. No publisher, segmented writer, compact checkpoint rotation, runtime reader switch, repository-external append anchor, or production path exists; the current v1 writer still atomically rewrites the whole cumulative ledger.
